title: skills: objectstack-data relationships rule says another master's detail is `reference_not_found` on import; after PR #37567 it is `reference_out_of_scope`
body:
repo:objectstack#2 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgV6i8jfWwSXjpWJrjA

Filing gate: ① · Source: fleet (the `Skills-docs: follow-up owed` line of PR #37567, Part of #36794)

## What happens

`skills/objectstack-data/rules/relationships.md` (around :115) teaches: "**Import resolves a detail's name within its master** when the row sets that master … or the lookup's `dependsOn` sibling: a tie there is `reference_ambiguous`, another master's detail `reference_not_found`."

PR #37567 gives that case its own reason: a scoped lookup miss whose value exists under another parent answers `reference_out_of_scope`, with an optional `scope` (`[{ field, value }]`) on the validate-data issue element. Once it merges, the skill's last clause is false. An agent that teaches or handles import errors from it will match `reference_not_found` for a case that no longer answers it.

`skills/**` is governed, and PR #37567 declares `Clause-②: yes`, so this sentence does not ride the code PR.

## Expected

- The clause reads that another master's detail is `reference_out_of_scope`, naming the scoping column through the issue's `scope`, and that `reference_not_found` remains for a value that exists under no parent (and for a caller who cannot read the scoping field, as #37567 keeps it).
- Paid for in the same file or bundle under the token ratchet (no ceiling moves).
- Written against the merged #37567 tree.

Blocked-by: #37567 (merge)
Category ①: a shipped skill states an error reason the platform will no longer answer.
Priority: p2, the grade of #36794 (an import error names the wrong reason; no data is lost).
Business reason: admins and agents importing rows into scoped lookups act on the reason code, so a wrong code sends them hunting for a record that exists.
Reader: seat 2 area s2-data (repo:objectstack#2), after #37567 merges. Tier H, so os-zhuang approves.
Dedupe: searched `reference_out_of_scope skills` and `relationships.md reference_not_found` (open issues): only #36794 itself.
Related: #36794, PR #37567.
